`solve_model` passes the current `n.snapshots` through `_as_model_snapshots`, which only converts snapshots when the model is detected as flat. If a model is built with a MultiIndex and the network’s snapshots are subsequently replaced by a single-level index, the callback receives that single-level index unchanged, not the representation used to build the model. Thus the guarantee does not hold for every network and call path.
